name: Restricted Local Proof Consistency Audit Registry

audit_targets.name: Operator Type Consistency
audit_targets.requirement: All operators in the proof segment must preserve declared input/output typing.

audit_targets.name: Restricted Scope Preservation
audit_targets.requirement: No proof step may implicitly invoke unrestricted or global continuation.

audit_targets.name: Failure Geometry Integrity
audit_targets.requirement: All preserved blockers and excluded domains must remain active and traceable.

audit_targets.name: Projection Sequence Coherence
audit_targets.requirement: The RLP-001 through RLP-005 sequence must not violate admissibility ordering.

audit_targets.name: LAW034 Composition Boundary Review
audit_targets.requirement: No local composition step may imply unresolved global compositional closure.

audit_targets.name: Counterexample Lineage Preservation
audit_targets.requirement: Every proof-supporting basin must remain linked to originating counterexample audits.

consistency_failure_classes.name: Implicit Globalization
consistency_failure_classes.meaning: A local proof step improperly assumes unrestricted continuation behavior.

consistency_failure_classes.name: Typing Drift
consistency_failure_classes.meaning: Operator input/output structure diverges from declared signature registry.

consistency_failure_classes.name: Boundary Collapse
consistency_failure_classes.meaning: Restricted admissibility boundaries become compositionally undefined.

consistency_failure_classes.name: Counterexample Severance
consistency_failure_classes.meaning: Proof support becomes detached from preserved failure lineage.

consistency_failure_classes.name: False Stability Attribution
consistency_failure_classes.meaning: Metastable or oscillatory basin incorrectly classified as stable.
